snippet.title: (Celeste) Crossover Collab - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
We've been working hard during this year, but we are very happy to announce some of our maps!
If you want to collaborate with us, you can contact @KoseiDiamond, @EllaTAS or @Lunasssy on Discord! (update: the Phase 2 form is now closed)
Stay tuned for more updates in the following months!

(Trailer by ashley_bl)

#celeste #crossovercollab #modding
